what_it_does: This paper combines two parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques for deploying large language models on limited hardware. Tensor-trained low-rank adapters (TT-LoRA) are lightweight modules that specialize a base model for individual tasks without duplicating the entire model. A mixture-of-experts (MoE) router selects exactly one task-specific adapter per input, activating only necessary computation. This two-stage approach reduces total computational overhead compared to using all expert modules simultaneously.
